business_problem: The bank needed to assess client ESG risk more consistently, simplify complex reporting, and reduce the manual work required to support sustainability compliance and onboarding decisions.
solution_summary: Capgemini built a data and AI risk platform for a multinational bank to standardize ESG assessments across client onboarding and regulatory reporting. At its core is an ESG reporting data lake that ingests internal client information alongside external datasets from providers such as CDP and the International Energy Agency. On top of that storage layer, Capgemini and the bank created an ESG Risk Assessment Tool with a questionnaire-driven interface that relationship managers use to evaluate clients against CESRA and EU taxonomy requirements. AI-driven models process the combined datasets to score physical risk, surface new client attributes, and reduce manual verification by climate-analytics teams. The result is an end-to-end workflow that moves ESG data from fragmented collection into a governed lake, applies model-based assessment, and returns standardized risk and compliance outputs with digital audit trails for broader regional rollout.

solution_components.name: ESG reporting data lake
solution_components.role: Stores and processes internal and external ESG data in one centralized platform.

solution_components.name: ESG Risk Assessment Tool
solution_components.role: Gives relationship managers a questionnaire-based interface for standardized ESG risk evaluation.

solution_components.name: AI-driven models
solution_components.role: Evaluate client physical risk and reporting data to reduce manual assessment effort and improve consistency.

data_flow: Internal client records and external ESG datasets from sources such as CDP and IEA are ingested into the ESG reporting data lake. AI-driven models and the ESG Risk Assessment Tool then transform that data into risk scores, onboarding assessments, compliance outputs, and audit-ready reporting artifacts for business teams.
business_outcome: The bank reduced manual ESG-assessment work, improved risk transparency and compliance readiness, and created a reusable data platform it can extend across regions and business units.
